partial.preview.clearProfile: Deletes the profile's storage directory (server_browser_profiles.rs). With the server browser off (T3CODE_RUST_SERVER_BROWSER unset) nothing has the storage open; with it on, the browser closes the profile's tabs first (server_browser_contexts.rs).
partial.preview.open: Tabs are tracked in memory and the desktop-runtime path works end to end (preview_manager.rs). A `server` runtime tab gets a page only when the server browser is switched on (T3CODE_RUST_SERVER_BROWSER=1, server_browser.rs); off, it is recorded but nothing renders it and `serverBrowser` is not advertised.

partial.GET /api/preview-stream/*: Built off: the frame stream, download and 4404/4503 closes are ported (server_browser_http.rs), but every one answers a plain 404 unless the server browser is switched on (T3CODE_RUST_SERVER_BROWSER=1).
partial.POST /api/preview-stream/upload: Built off: the picker upload is ported (server_browser_http.rs) and answers a plain 404 unless the server browser is switched on (T3CODE_RUST_SERVER_BROWSER=1).

pending.html_preview: Listed; fails as the original's HTML renderer does without a browser.
pending.html_render: Listed; fails as the original's HTML renderer does without a browser (htmlRender/headlessChrome.ts not ported).

partial.preview_open: Runs on whichever browser host is registered with the broker (preview_automation_broker.rs). The server's own browser registers as the preferred host only when it is switched on (T3CODE_RUST_SERVER_BROWSER=1, server_browser.rs); the desktop's channel is not ported, so with the switch off every browser tool answers PreviewAutomationNoAvailableHostError, as the original does with no host.

clientOnly.addProjectBaseDirectory: The original's server never reads it (clients do).
clientOnly.pullRequestMergeMethod: A project-scoped key the clients resolve; the original's server only lists it among the project-scoped keys.
clientOnly.projectAutoPullOverrides: A derived view of projectSettingsOverrides, maintained by the settings model (server_settings_model.rs).
clientOnly.projectAgentBrowserAccessOverrides: A derived view of projectSettingsOverrides, maintained by the settings model (server_settings_model.rs).

partial.serverBrowser: Built off: advertised only when the server browser is switched on (T3CODE_RUST_SERVER_BROWSER=1; environment_capabilities::advertised_for), unlike the original, which always advertises it.
